fallback.reason: The two original candidates failed eligibility. Inspect a fixed 500-ID interval beginning at the lower original ID rounded down to the nearest 1,000.

selection: First candidate with positive unchanged liquidity, unchanged NFT fee accounting, and no manager updates during the fixed week. Stop after this bounded list if none qualifies.
dataFailure: Stop with an incomplete capture; do not skip a candidate because its historical data is unavailable.
